milestones.title: Phase 1: Encrypted Apple Watch & iPhone HealthKit Bridge
milestones.description: Deliver the Tri-Device Architecture Blueprint, encrypted `/api/mobile/health/ingest` endpoint, FFD Workout Readiness Score engine, and iOS Shortcuts / Health Auto Export integration.

milestones.title: Phase 2: iPhone Pocket Cockpit PWA & High-Speed Voice Relay
milestones.description: Deliver the installable iOS Progressive Web App (PWA), Tailscale + AFCC Root CA mTLS provisioning, 1.5x-3x speed Voice Profile with 'Mahadev' wake word, and live Action-Item Conversational Engine.

milestones.title: Phase 3: 1-Tap Open Payment Deep-Link Engine (BHIM / ICICI / UPI)
milestones.description: Deliver 1-Tap UPI & Bank App deep-link generation (`bhim://pay`, `imobileapp://`, `tez://upi/pay`, `phonepe://pay`, `upi://pay`) for Monthly Action Items with automatic SQLite + encrypted vault closure.

milestones.title: Phase 4: Apple Watch Smart Stack Complication & Siri AppIntents
milestones.description: Deliver the ultra-lightweight `/api/mobile/watch/complication` snapshot endpoint, WidgetKit Smart Stack complication, and Apple Watch Action Button / Siri AppIntents voice bridge.

deliverables.title: [TD-01] Tri-Device System Architecture & Zero-Cloud Threat Model Blueprint
deliverables.summary: Author the comprehensive Tri-Device Architecture blueprint covering Apple Watch sensor ingestion, iPhone Pocket Cockpit & UPI deep-link orchestration, and Windows Laptop sovereign AFCC storage.
acceptance_criteria: Document complete tri-device topology with Mermaid architecture & sequence diagrams
Specify zero-cloud security boundaries (Tailscale WireGuard + AFCC Local Root CA mTLS + AES-256-GCM)
Define problem statements solved across Health, Monthly Payments, and Hands-Free Voice

deliverables.title: [TD-02] Encrypted Apple Health & Watch Biometric Ingestion API (/api/mobile/health/ingest)
deliverables.summary: Implement the local REST API endpoint `/api/mobile/health/ingest` to receive Apple Watch & HealthKit metrics (Steps, Active Energy, Resting HR, HRV SDNN, Sleep, SpO2, Glucose, Hydration), persist them into SQLite and AES-256-GCM encrypted vault storage, and compute an automatic FFD Workout Readiness Score.
acceptance_criteria: Support batch ingestion of steps, resting_hr_bpm, hrv_sdnn_ms, sleep_hours, spo2_pct, active_kcal, fasting_glucose, and water_ml
Encrypt raw Apple Health payloads at rest in `fleet/data/user/apple_health_sync_vault.json` using AES-256-GCM + HKDF-SHA256
Compute deterministic 0-100 FFD Workout Readiness Score and recommend Mudgal/Samtola/Bhim Gadha intensity adjustments

deliverables.title: [TD-03] iOS Shortcuts & Health Auto Export Automated Background Sync Recipe
deliverables.summary: Provide a 1-click importable iOS Shortcut definition and `/api/mobile/shortcuts/template` endpoint so iPhone automatically pushes HealthKit & Watch metrics to the Laptop Hub when charging or joining Wi-Fi/Tailscale.
acceptance_criteria: Expose `GET /api/mobile/shortcuts/template` returning ready-to-import iOS Shortcut JSON configuration
Support X-AFCC-Device-Token header validation with constant-time comparison

deliverables.title: [TD-04] Watch HRV, Sleep & Resting HR Auto-Adaptation for 6-Day Mudgal/Samtola/Bhim Gadha Split
deliverables.summary: Automatically correlate Apple Watch overnight HRV (SDNN) and sleep duration with the Health & Wellness 6-day traditional strength split to dynamically suggest recovery vs. peak volume sets.
acceptance_criteria: Flag recovery mode when sleep_hours < 6.0 or hrv_sdnn_ms < 30
Surface readiness badge on Health & Wellness dashboard and Morning Briefing

deliverables.title: [TD-05] Mobile-Responsive AFCC Pocket Cockpit PWA & Home Screen Web App Manifest
deliverables.summary: Add iOS Safari Progressive Web App (PWA) support (`apple-mobile-web-app-capable`, `manifest.webmanifest`) so AFCC runs as a full-screen native-feel app on iPhone.
acceptance_criteria: Serve PWA manifest and iOS standalone meta tags
Provide touch-friendly Action Item cards and 1-tap voice mic button on mobile viewports

deliverables.title: [TD-06] High-Speed Voice Cockpit (1.5x-3x Speed, 'Mahadev' Wake Word & Live Action-Item Conversation)
deliverables.summary: Enable 1.5x, 1.75x, 2x, 2.5x, and 3x speech playback speeds, configurable wake word defaulting to 'Mahadev', and a zero-latency (<5ms, $0.00) stateful conversational engine to review, close, edit, reprioritize, and reopen action items verbally.
acceptance_criteria: Support 1.5x, 1.75x, 2x, 2.5x, and 3x voice speeds in both Voice Cockpit and Settings modal
Default wake word to 'Mahadev' with user customization
Support natural verbal conversation on open and already-closed action items ('close it', 'I already closed...', 'edit it to...', 'next action item', 'reopen it')

deliverables.title: [TD-07] Tailscale WireGuard Mesh & iOS Local Root CA (afcc_root_ca.crt) Trust Onboarding
deliverables.summary: Provide seamless onboarding for trusting `afcc_root_ca.crt` on iOS (`Settings -> Profile Downloaded -> Certificate Trust Settings`) over local Wi-Fi and Tailscale mesh.
acceptance_criteria: Provide downloadable root certificate endpoint for iOS profile installation
Verify TLS 1.3 / 1.2 SAN coverage for localhost, 127.0.0.1, and LAN/Tailscale IPs

deliverables.title: [TD-08] 1-Tap Open Payment Deep-Link Engine (BHIM UPI, ICICI iMobile, GPay, PhonePe)
deliverables.summary: Implement `/api/mobile/payments/deeplink` to generate pre-filled NPCI UPI & Bank deep links (`bhim://pay`, `imobileapp://`, `tez://upi/pay`, `phonepe://pay`, `upi://pay`) for Monthly Action Items so the user only taps 'Pay' on iPhone and approves via FaceID/UPI PIN.
acceptance_criteria: Generate RFC-compliant UPI deep links for BHIM, ICICI iMobile, Google Pay, PhonePe, and generic UPI
Support `confirm_paid: true` callback to immediately close the corresponding Monthly Action Item in SQLite and encrypted vault

deliverables.title: [TD-09] Automated Post-Payment Action-Item Closure & Receipt Reference Audit Log
deliverables.summary: Allow 1-tap iOS Shortcut callback or voice confirmation ('Mahadev, I already paid the electricity bill') to attach a payment timestamp/UTR note and mark the monthly task completed.
acceptance_criteria: Record payment completion timestamp and app used in task description/activity log
Sync closed status to encrypted `personal_tasks_vault.json`

deliverables.title: [TD-10] Apple Watch Smart Stack Complication & WidgetKit Snapshot API (/api/mobile/watch/complication)
deliverables.summary: Implement the ultra-compact (<2 KB, <5ms) `/api/mobile/watch/complication` endpoint delivering Hydration Ring %, Today's Workout, Open Action Items count, Top Priority Action Item, and Readiness Score for watchOS complications and iOS Lock Screen widgets.
acceptance_criteria: Return compact JSON payload under 2 KB in <5ms
Include hydration progress %, today's 6-day strength workout, open/closed action item counts, and readiness score
Support 1-tap quick actions (`+250ml Water`, `Close Top Action Item`) directly from watchOS / iOS Shortcut complication

deliverables.title: [TD-11] Apple Watch Action Button & Siri AppIntents Voice Bridge ('Ask Mahadev')
deliverables.summary: Connect Apple Watch Action Button and Siri Shortcuts to `/api/voice/converse` so raising your wrist and speaking 'Log a glass of water' or 'What are my open action items?' speaks the response directly on Apple Watch.
acceptance_criteria: Document and expose Siri Shortcut voice relay recipe targeting `/api/voice/converse`
Return clean plain-text `spoken_reply` optimized for watchOS Speak Text action

deliverables.title: [TD-12] Automated GitHub Project Governance, CI Verification Gate & Zero-Cloud Telemetry Sync
deliverables.summary: Automate end-to-end GitHub Project management (Labels, Milestones, Master Epic, 12 Sub-Issues, GitHub Actions Job Summary, Wiki Sync, Pages Roadmap, and AFCC `/api/github/projects/tri-device` telemetry).
acceptance_criteria: Idempotently provision and synchronize Labels, Milestones, Master Epic, and 12 Deliverable Issues on GitHub
Publish Markdown Kanban & Milestone progress report to GitHub Actions Step Summary, GitHub Wiki, and GitHub Pages
Enforce 100% Zero-Cloud personal data firewall on all GitHub sync payloads
